scripts.typecheck: vue-tsc -p types/tsconfig.vue2.json && vue-tsc -p types/tsconfig.vue2.skiplib.json && vue-tsc -p types/tsconfig.vue3.json && vue-tsc -p types/tsconfig.vue3.skiplib.json && pnpm typecheck:resolution
scripts.typecheck:resolution: for c in bundler node16 nodenext; do for v in vue3 vue2; do tsc -p types/resolution/tsconfig.$c.$v.json || exit 1; done; done
